album.intro: An album inspired by George Orwell’s novel, blending modern new wave and electronic post-punk.
album.coverAlt: 1984 cover: a glass paperweight with red coral against a dark wall crossed by a beam of light.
album.caption: Nineteen Eighty-Four
work.label: Behind the slogans
work.description: Writing in secret, holding on to a memory, reaching for another person: ordinary gestures become acts of resistance. The album stays close to Orwell’s characters, their private refuges and the violence that threatens them.
single.label: The single
single.description: Winston follows Julia into a clearing that recalls the landscape of his dreams. Beneath the hazel trees, fear gives way to desire, then tenderness. The film follows this growing sense of ease: flashes of the city still intrude, before yielding to shared glances, quiet gestures and wind through the leaves.

band.label: The band
band.intro: Velvet Index is an imagined band created with artificial intelligence, under Onchainfinity’s artistic direction.
band.description: Its voices, music and visual world take shape through generative tools. Blending modern new wave and electronic post-punk, the bass drives the movement while the voices explore the characters’ inner lives.
process.label: The artistic approach
process.title: A continent to explore.
process.description: Onchainfinity approaches language models as a continent to explore: a landscape shaped by traces of our stories, knowledge and imagination. Creating means seeking human resonance within that landscape, then selecting, reshaping and connecting the forms that emerge.
process.album: With 1984, this exploration follows Orwell’s characters through their fears, desires and gestures of tenderness.
